One Bedroom Flat · Furnished · Available September 2022

Acorn Properties are delighted to offer for rent this spacious one bedroom apartment situated on Burdon Terrace, Jesmond, located in the heart of Brandling Village Conservation Area! Within walking distance to Newcastle City Centre, this property is perfectly suited to young professionals who commute into the City Centre, the RVI and Jesmond alike. The property comprises of entrance hallway, large living room with space for dining table, kitchen with breakfast bar, double bedroom and bathroom. The accommodation is available furnished or unfurnished and benefits from off-street parking to the rear. To view call Acorn Properties today.
